answer: Require each new agent to post collateral and earn trust through signed referrals from already-established agents, with rewards vesting only after several independently verified interactions. A swarm of fresh identities cannot manufacture that history: each must recruit credible sponsors and lock capital that can be slashed if their referrals repeatedly misbehave. The vine of referrals spreads slowly, so the signal is costly to fake; an attacker pays in funds, time, and reputation across the ocean of agents.
